answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes; the security release cannot be rolled back. memory_b2 is the closest prior on a regional latency fault and claimed a clean shift, so it is the leading option to verify. memory_b5 is the main alternative if primary write latency is actually read/report contention rather than a regional fault. Circuit breaking risks dropping customer writes; adding capacity was historically pre-peak and may not fix a region-scoped fault. Peak settlement makes any cutover a downstream-value risk, so keep this a standard experiment rather than a blind broad cut, and treat the regional diagnosis as still uncertain until the two archives are checked.
